philosophy: Promotes the regime_mild_bull emitter on the ETF surface — long broad-index ETFs (SPY/QQQ/IWM/EEM/GLD) only when a 'mild bull' regime classifier fires. EXTREMELY thin n=2 win-only sample; this persona exists only to accumulate honest closed-trade volume in shadow.
entry_criteria: regime_mild_bull classifier in 'BULL_MILD' state (SPY 50SMA up-sloping AND VIX < 20 AND no recent breadth-thrust violation)
Target ETF in tournament universe (SPY, QQQ, IWM, EEM, GLD)
ADV > $500M (ETF liquidity is rarely a problem)
exit_criteria: Regime classifier exits BULL_MILD (transitions to NEUTRAL or BEAR)
Hard time-stop: 30 trading days (ETF resolution window)
Hard ATR stop: 2x 20-day ATR from entry
suggested_backtesting_protocol: ETF universe daily bars 2018-2025. Tag regime windows. Compare BULL_MILD-tagged returns vs all-weather buy-and-hold. n>=30 needed before any live discussion.
confidence_calibration: HIGH only in shadow review — n=2 is statistically meaningless. Treat all signals as MEDIUM until n>=30.
best_market_conditions: Earnings season with positive surprise rate > 70%

live_stats_validation_2026_05_31.note: n=2 is artifact-sized. Do NOT cite these stats as edge proof. Other categories (crypto n=1 -4.5%) suggest classifier may not generalize.

operator_activation_steps: 1. Verify regime_mild_bull NOT in PERMANENTLY_KILLED (confirmed clean).
2. Restrict persona to ETF asset_class only (block crypto/stocks branches — they leaked into raw data with poor results).
4. Assign to 1-2 macro-aware models (claude_opus, ring_261T) in model_persona_mapping.json under ETF.
5. Shadow MANDATORY until n>=30 closed ETF picks; do NOT consider live sizing on n=2.
kill_registry_check: PASSED — regime_mild_bull not in any kill list.
